body_html:
#smallpoems
Frightening lighting
tears above our darkened mast
Frigid fists crawl above the bow
unrepentant wrath
creaking, the craft grasps
as froth crashes
heightening fury
sailors stand aghast
a whitening worry
seeing their ghost
before fate
is cast
